name: agent-ping-global
description: Global desktop signal wheel for DSH Agent Ping.

scripts.package: npm run sync && electron-packager . AgentPing --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.ico --ignore="^/(node_modules|\.pack-cache|\.npm-cache|\.electron-profile|\.hotkey-profile|\.final-profile|\.task-profile|\.data|\.cmd-profile.*|release|test-.*\.js|app-.*\.txt|h-.*\.txt|p-.*\.txt|task.*\.log|agent-ping-global\.log)" && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-shortcut.ps1
